_about: The ONLY file with project-specific values. build.py reads it. Keys that start with _ are comments.
_repo_path: Path of the target repo checkout, relative to this folder. The build reads code from it and never changes it.
_repo_host: github, gitlab or gitea. Sets the format of the code links.
_sha: The full 40-character commit id that the site explains. The build fails if the checkout is at another commit.

extra_repos._about: Other pinned repos that pages cite. Cite with the key as prefix: {{cite vllm:path:line}}, <x-code repo="vllm" ...>. The build fails if a checkout is at another commit.

_language_style: ste = ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (the build warns on sentences over ste_max_words); plain = no sentence-length check.
_comment_language: Language of code comments that <x-tr> translates, for example Chinese. Empty = the label says only 'Translated comments'.
_prism_components: Prism language files to load from cdnjs. Add for example prism-rust, prism-go, prism-java, prism-typescript.
_lang_by_ext: Extra file-extension to Prism-language mappings, for example {".rs": "rust", ".go": "go"}.
